## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the problem and what this change delivers. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Explain any checks that could not run.

## Compatibility and limitations

Describe relevant behavior changes, security boundaries, and remaining work.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Targets `dev`, or explains the release/hotfix exception.
- [ ] Scope follows the agreed design; planned capabilities are labeled.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or unexplained dependency changes are included.
- [ ] Third-party material has appropriate licensing and attribution.
